note: Private campground on a 140-acre Cherokee Lake peninsula, mostly seasonal, with a swimming beach, two launch ramps with courtesy docks and a camp store. No alcohol, firearms or generators. --Claude
summary: Greenlee of Fall Creek: ResNexus rates $35-59 (W/E 30 A $35, full-hookup 50 A $59), flat Nov 2026 and May 2027; 128 sites, 79 seasonal (62%), 29 nightly RV, 20 tent; 2-night min, 3 on holidays; year-round. PIN is on the neighbouring Fall Creek Marina And Campground ~690 m SE; the stored lakefront evidence was read there too. Waterfront downgrade to lakeview recommended. Google 4.5 (111).
flags: PIN MOVE (~690 m): stored 36.2884,-83.2222 sits on Fall Creek Marina And Campground (5656 Fall Creek Dock Rd, Google pin 36.28831,-83.22179), a separate park across the cove. Target 36.2912,-83.2290, the middle of Greenlee's three sections on the peninsula to the northwest (Google pins the address at 36.29409,-83.23355, the west end of the peninsula).

WATERFRONT (stored 'lakefront', not --AWH; recommend lakeview): the stored evidence ('satellite at 36.2870,-83.2205: front RV rows on open grass/sand apron') describes Fall Creek Marina And Campground, not Greenlee. Greenlee sells nightly RV sites it names 'Lakefront' (A1, A3, A5, A7, A9, B5, B7, plus Section C sites) and others 'Lakeview' (B8, B9, B16, B18). On Esri imagery the shore-road row between Sections B and A (~36.29106,-83.22785 and ~36.29104,-83.22811) sits on open grass ~35-40 m from the sand line; 3DEP gives the pads 332.7-334.0 m against a ~327 m summer pool, 5.7-7 m up a ~9 deg grass slope. The map image is not to scale, so no pad could be tied to a site number. With no named site confirmed within ~50 m and 1-2 m of the summer edge, this goes down to lakeview; a site-level photo of A1-A9 or B5/B7 could restore lakefront.

LONG-STAY: 79 of 128 sites (62%) are seasonal (wait list, 'vacation destination only'); 49 sites (38%) rent nightly, 29 of them RV sites. The park is not iffy: posted rates, live ResNexus booking, Google 4.5 (111 reviews), phone 423-587-8866. It stays, and the note says it is mostly seasonal.

LEAD - checked, not qualifying: Fall Creek Marina And Campground (5656 Fall Creek Dock Rd, Russellville; 36.2883,-83.2218; fallcreekmarinaandcampground.com; 423-581-4701; Google 4.5/197) is not in campgrounds.json. Its campground page lists only seasonal and monthly-looking rates ($160-1,600, metered electric, 'not open to full time living') with no nightly rate, so it does not qualify as listed.
